name: Crimson Curse raises bleed damage taken on a critical strike (#3086)
contract: Crimson Curse 706656 reads 'Your direct damage critical strikes increase the damage the target takes from bleed effects by $560288s1% for $560288d'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Lacerations 560288 (MOD_MECHANIC_DAMAGE_TAKEN_PERCENT, MiscValue 15 = MECHANIC_BLEED, BasePoints 29 -> +30%, duration index 8, TargetA 6). Spell.dbc gives 706656 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and no crit ever applied the debuff. Bloodbolt is cast as rank 578305 (the rank a level-80 character owns; 578304 is only granted up to level 52 and gets no server response) and spell_crit_rating 100000 makes the critical strike deterministic instead of hoping for one.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Crimson Curse passive is active
No Lacerations debuff before any cast
DISCRIMINATING: a critical Bloodbolt applies Lacerations 560288
Lacerations grants the DBC value of +30% bleed damage taken
